checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Three separate square images, not a collage
must.why: Three separate 640x640 square images, each a single scene.

must.item: Bottle matches original silhouette, proportions, lid, matte black finish
must.why: The white image is close. The outdoor and gym bottles are stubbier and wider than the original. The outdoor lid has a squarer loop and a flatter top. The gym lid also differs slightly. The finish stays matte black.

must.item: White-background image shows entire bottle with wooden table removed
must.why: The whole bottle sits on clean white and the table is gone. The shot is a slight three-quarter angle with a soft shadow.

must.item: Lifestyle image places bottle convincingly on gym bench
must.why: The bottle stands on a black bench between towels, with gym equipment blurred behind it. Scale and grounding look plausible.

must.item: Close-up clearly shows lid and matte surface without inventing features
must.why: No close-up was made. The three images are white, outdoor and gym.
No text or logos appear in any image.

faults.what: The outdoor and gym bottles are shorter and wider than the original, and the lid details differ, so the product does not exactly match.
No close-up detail shot was made, although the brief implies one.
The outdoor scene is over-stylised with heavy golden haze and looks AI-generated.
The white-background bottle is shown at a slight angle with a flat, CGI-like look.

summary: The agent made three clean square images (white, outdoor, gym) with no text, but the outdoor and gym bottles are stubbier than the real one, and there is no close-up shot.
